faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: What is the difference between made-to-order and toll manufacturing?
faq.a1: In made-to-order production we source the vegetable oil and manage the whole process to your specification. In toll manufacturing you supply the raw material and we convert it at our facility, with batch traceability and confidentiality.
faq.a2: Rapeseed, sunflower and soybean oil are our standard feedstocks. Other vegetable oils, including high-oleic and specialty oils, are possible on request.
faq.a3: Typical batches are 10–20 tonnes, and our two production lines can produce up to 60 tonnes per day. Pilot batches are available on request.
faq.a4: In bulk by road tanker or in 1,000 L IBCs. Other packaging can be arranged on request.
faq.q5: Which analyses do you carry out, and which documents do you provide?
faq.a5: Each batch is analysed in our in-house laboratory: ester content, acid value, water content, density, viscosity, flash point, colour and other parameters as your specification requires. A certificate of analysis is provided for each batch, and safety and technical data sheets are available on request.
faq.q6: Can you develop a custom formulation?
faq.a6: Yes. We blend vegetable methyl esters with additives to your specification, test them in our laboratory and scale up from pilot batches to industrial production.
faq.q7: Where are you located and which markets do you supply?
faq.a7: We are in Săcueni, Bihor County, Romania, near the Hungarian border. We supply customers in Romania, Hungary, Austria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Poland, Germany and beyond.
faq.q8: What should I send to receive a quote?
faq.a8: The product or feedstock you need, the estimated volume, your specification (or technical data sheet), the delivery location and your timing. Use the form below or email us.

intro.title: Choose your ester
intro.lead: RME, SFME and SME cover most industrial applications. If your process needs a different feedstock or a specific property, our Custom Esters and Custom Formulation services adapt the product to you.

specNote.title: Properties confirmed on every batch
specNote.text: Exact values for ester content, density, viscosity, acid value, water content, flash point and colour depend on the feedstock and your specification. We confirm them for every batch with a Certificate of Analysis, and can provide an indicative Technical Data Sheet before you order.

rme.title: Rapeseed Methyl Ester
rme.lead: A versatile, renewable ester with excellent cold-flow properties.
rme.overview: RME is produced from rapeseed oil using our cavitation and ultrasonic process, manufactured to your specification rather than to a fixed technical sheet. Rapeseed-derived esters are known for good low-temperature (cold-flow) behaviour compared with other vegetable esters, which makes RME a common choice where a product needs to perform in cooler conditions.

feature.e: Available in bulk or 1,000 L IBC

rme.bestFor: Industrial applications needing good cold-flow behaviour

sfme.title: Sunflower Methyl Ester
sfme.lead: A renewable ester from sunflower oil, made to your specification.
sfme.overview: SFME is produced from sunflower oil on the same process platform as RME. It is a versatile base for industrial formulations and, like all our esters, is manufactured and quality-checked to your specification rather than to a single fixed grade.

feature.e: Available in bulk or 1,000 L IBC

sme.overview: SME is produced from soybean oil and supplied for industrial, technical and agrochemical-formulation applications. As with RME and SFME, we manufacture it to your specification and verify every batch in our laboratory.

intro.title: One platform, many industries
intro.lead: Vegetable methyl esters and custom formulations serve as carriers, solvents and functional components across a range of industries. Choose your industry below to see what we typically adapt.

agrochemicals.title: Agrochemicals
agrochemicals.lead: A renewable carrier and formulation component for crop-protection products.
agrochemicals.text: Vegetable methyl esters are used as carriers and co-solvents in agrochemical formulations — herbicides, insecticides, fungicides and growth regulators. As a formulation component in EC, EW and SC systems, they can improve the solubility and stability of active ingredients, while offering a renewable, biodegradable alternative to mineral-oil-based carriers.

coatings.title: Coatings, Paints & Inks
coatings.lead: A bio-based solvent and reactive component.
coatings.text: In coatings, paints, resins and inks, our esters work as a solvent or reactive component, offering a renewable alternative to some mineral-oil-based ingredients. We can adjust the feedstock and specification to match your formulation.

lubricants.title: Lubricants & Metalworking Fluids
lubricants.lead: A base component and performance additive.
lubricants.text: Vegetable methyl esters are used as a base fluid or performance additive in lubricants, and as a component in metalworking fluids for cutting, grinding and forming operations. Feedstock and additive package are selected to match the performance profile you need.

point.a: Base component and performance additive for lubricants
point.b: Component for cutting, grinding and forming fluids
point.c: Can be combined with additives via our Custom Formulation service

cleaners.lead: A renewable base for degreasing and cleaning formulations.
cleaners.text: Used as a base or active component in industrial cleaning and degreasing formulations, offering a renewable alternative to some solvent-based ingredients.

point.a: Base or active component for degreasing formulations
point.b: Renewable alternative to some solvent-based ingredients

polymers.title: Polymers & Plastics
polymers.text: In polymer and plastics processing, vegetable methyl esters can act as a plasticiser or processing aid, offering a bio-based alternative in formulations where that matters to your product or your customers.

chemicals.text: As an intermediate, vegetable methyl esters are used in a variety of downstream industrial chemical products. Esters and glycerin (a by-product of our process) are also used in soil-stabilisation applications. Tell us your target application and we'll confirm whether a standard ester or a custom formulation fits best.

intro.title: How we convert oil into ester
intro.text: Vegetable oil reacts with methanol in the presence of a catalyst (transesterification), producing methyl ester and glycerin as a by-product. Our process combines hydrodynamic cavitation with ultrasonic finishing to intensify that reaction: cavitation creates microbubbles and high mixing energy that bring the oil and methanol into closer, faster contact, and the ultrasonic stage further refines the mix before separation.

cavitation.title: Hydrodynamic Cavitation
cavitation.text: Creates microbubbles and high local mixing energy, improving contact between the oil and methanol and speeding up the reaction.

ultrasound.title: Ultrasonic Finishing
ultrasound.text: A second processing stage that further improves mixing and helps produce a consistent, homogeneous product.

automation.title: Process Monitoring & Control
automation.text: Our production lines are monitored to keep conditions consistent from batch to batch, supporting repeatable quality.

advantages.title: What this means for your product
advantages.a: Intensified mixing and mass transfer between oil and methanol
advantages.b: A repeatable process, batch to batch
advantages.c: Flexible from pilot batches to full production runs
advantages.d: Works with a range of vegetable-oil feedstocks

who.title: Who we are
who.text: BIOCETAN is a Romanian company specialised in processing vegetable oils and producing vegetable methyl esters and custom liquid formulations. Our facility in Săcueni, Bihor County, combines modern process technology with a flexible manufacturing model. We work with industrial clients, formulators and distributors, offering made-to-order production, toll manufacturing and product-development support — from pilot batches to full-scale production.

approach.title: Our approach
approach.text: We aim for a practical, efficient use of renewable resources. Combining hydrodynamic processing, careful separation and precise formulation, we help our partners develop products adapted to their markets and applications.

d.title: European reach
d.text: Local resources, regional and European markets.
